faces.name: Creeping Dread
faces.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player discards a card. Each opponent who discarded a card that shares a card type with the card you discarded loses 3 life. (Players reveal the discarded cards simultaneously.)

triggered.raw_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player discards a card. Each opponent who discarded a card that shares a card type with the card you discarded loses 3 life. (Players reveal the discarded cards simultaneously.)

effects.text: Each opponent who discarded a card that shares a card type with the card you discarded loses 3 life
